title: Elodie and the Colony
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Lena Winterbourne, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
